mechanism: Amikacin (aminoglycoside) causes nephrotoxicity and ototoxicity, while terbinafine undergoes hepatic metabolism; combined use increases risk of renal impairment which reduces amikacin clearance and increases terbinafine exposure.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, BUN) regularly during concurrent therapy; adjust amikacin dosing if renal impairment develops; assess hearing changes as aminoglycosides are ototoxic.
